Subject: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API + secure delivery options

Hi Dylan,

We're updating our vendor security inventory and need the latest penetration test report and a short note on the scope that covers the Hosted API (public endpoints, auth flows, token handling). Specifically:

- A redacted copy of the most recent penetration test report (we can accept a version with sensitive IP redacted).
- Confirmation that the test included the hosted API surface (list of components/endpoints tested).
- Secure transfer options and expected TTL for any presigned link or portal access.

We also need to attach this to our SIG questionnaire; please call out whether there are any open remediation items and their ETA (or reference to a tracker).

Can you share the report and transfer method by EOD Mon (4/4)? Let me know if you need an NDA or additional details.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Security Program Manager
Acme Corp
[security@acme-corp.com]

--
Acme Corp uses TLS and SSO. This email may contain sensitive procurement information.

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a redacted PDF of our March 2027 pen test that covers the Hosted API surface. I'll coordinate internally on redactions and confirm the list of endpoints included in scope.

Options for secure delivery we typically support:
- Time-limited pre-signed S3 link (recommended) with 7-day TTL by default.
- Encrypted ZIP with password shared via a separate channel (Teams/phone).
- Temporary, access-controlled SharePoint/Secure Portal (for customers on enterprise plans).

Rishi (security) — can you confirm whether there are any open remediation items we should call out and whether a 7-day presigned S3 link is OK to share with Acme?

Monica — fyi for account records (ACME-ENT-2027Q2). Alex asked for scope confirmation and remediation ETAs — would be great to have a short bullet list to append.

I can prepare the redacted PDF and the presign if we get the green light on TTL.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[dylan_brooks@redwood.ai]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API + secure delivery options

Thanks — quick update from security side.

- Report: March 2027 internal engagement by third-party pen test vendor (full scope attached to internal folder). We can produce a customer-facing redacted PDF that removes IPs/endpoints used for internal infra and any PII.
- Scope covered: Hosted API public endpoints (v1/generate, v1/chat, token exchange endpoints), auth service, rate-limiting layer, and perimeter load balancers. It did NOT include customer-managed Private deployments.
- Open remediation items: 2 low/med findings currently in remediation (CVE-tracking for a third-party lib and an auth header logging artifact). ETA: both are scheduled and expected closed in the next 4 weeks; we can provide sprint/PR references on request.

Secure transfer recommendations (ordered by our preference):
1) Pre-signed S3 URL expiring 7 days, link delivered over email, password share via separate channel if requested.
2) Short-lived (48h) secure portal session with MFA (recommended for long-term customers).
3) Password-protected archive (if customer cannot accept presigned URL).

If Acme needs an NDA, we can sign an inbound NDA quickly; otherwise presigned S3 with a 7-day TTL and a short redaction is the fastest.

I'll coordinate with Infra to generate the redacted PDF and provide a direct presign when ready.

Rishi
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
[rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai]
